description: Build an IBAN from national bank details (bank code, branch code, account number). Adds the IBAN check digits and, where the country has them, the national check digits such as the French RIB key or the Italian CIN. Use iban_format to see which parts a country needs.

check_digits.description: National check digits, only where they are not computed

name: calculate_iban
title: Calculate an IBAN
